rules.title: Just Cause For Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate a tenancy without just cause (at-fault reasons or specified no-fault reasons). No-fault evictions require relocation assistance, and eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within three business days of service.
rules.status_basis: Described as existing City of Los Angeles ordinance on LAHD page.

requires.text: The JCO can apply to buildings that are newer than October 1, 1978 (units not under the RSO).

exempt_if.name: special_housing_types
exempt_if.text: transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some non-profit homeless facilities or treatment centers, some HACLA or government-owned properties

exempt_if.name: tenancy_length
exempt_if.text: Applies only once the tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or the original lease expired, whichever comes first

coverage.summary: Covers most Los Angeles residential rentals not regulated by the Rent Stabilization Ordinance, including single-family dwellings.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate, some cooperatives, some nonprofit facilities and some government-owned properties.

rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.

rules.title: AB 1482, the California Tenant Protection Act of 2019
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are capped at 5% plus the regional cost-of-living change, or 10%, whichever is lower, for covered buildings older than 15 years.
rules.key_value: 5% plus local CPI change, max 10%; 8.9% for 1 Aug 2024 to 31 Jul 2025

requires.text: may regulate the rent amount in buildings that are older than 15 years old (rolling basis)

exempt_if.name: deed_restricted_affordable
exempt_if.text: Units restricted by a deed, regulatory restrictions, or other recorded document limiting affordability to low or moderate-income households

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: second unit occupied by an owner for the entire period of the tenancy

exempt_if.name: owner_not_corporate_and_written_notice
exempt_if.text: not owned by a real estate trust, corporation, or LLC with a corporate member, and tenant notified in writing

coverage.summary: Limits annual rent increases in California buildings more than 15 years old.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts buildings under 15 years old, deed-restricted units, certain dormitories, qualifying owner-occupied two-unit properties and qualifying single-family homes and condominiums.

rules.quoted_span: Annual rent increases are limited to no more than 5% plus the percentage change in the cost of living for the region in which the property is located, or 10% whichever is lower
